summary: Reuse an active Bitcoin baseline without rescanning the retained UTXO snapshot on restart
details: Native node startup skips the redundant raw-file SHA-256 scan when live Core RPC confirms the pinned baseline and the existing regular file has the expected size.

First-time Core loads and missing-file downloads retain full verification. Native balance-history independently verifies both source hashes when importing, while sealed databases retain their existing state and identity checks.
Standalone file preparation remains strict by default; the native Compose configuration explicitly enables reuse for independently verifying downstream consumers.
Progress reports identify the reused baseline as ready instead of showing another file verification stage. Background historical validation remains independent.
operator_actions: Upgrade the node kit and Bitcoin runtime image together; the bundled native startup configuration enables this optimization.
